metadata.name: Customer Service Call - Order Status Inquiry
metadata.description: Customer calls to check order status, agent follows script

messages.text: Thank you for calling customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I placed an order last week and I haven't received any updates. Order number is 12345.
I understand your concern. Let me look up your order. Can you confirm your email address?
Thank you. I see your order here. It shipped yesterday and should arrive by Friday. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome! Have a great day and thank you for your business.
